results.title: Birdwatching rewires the brain and slows cognitive decline
results.description: Birdwatching can help slow brain ageing and is increasingly being used as therapy for dementia patients.

results.title: Billions spent abroad as patients question care at home
results.description: From unreliable diagnoses to rushed consultations and higher treatment costs, patients explain why they seek care abroad, while doctors warn that commercial interests are also driving the exodus Details
